```plato

    // The sum of all vertex degrees. By the handshake lemma this is twice the
    // edge count, whether the graph is directed (in-degree plus out-degree) or
    // undirected (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Handshaking_lemma).
    DegreeSum(self: IGraph): Integer
        => self.EdgeCount * 2;
```
